value.description: Miscellaneous gears, capacitors, circuit boards, tubes, wheels, sensors, wires, chips, processors, and other electronic and industrial parts. Necessary for assembling complex machines or electronics.\n\nA mad influencer said they were advanced components. They were wrong, as usual.

Adapted from old solar technology, radiation panels are capable of capturing small amounts of the microwave energy being bent by the black hole into the visible spectrum. This can produce a small amount of power, though not nearly as much as a traditional solar panel under a real star.
Build radiation panels for electricity generation
The local black hole has emitted a surge of mysterious, immeasurable Hawking radiation, interfering with electronic devices.

value.letterText:
A Hawking interference event, a result of unknown levels of radiation surging from the local black hole, has begun.

The intense radiation will shut down all electrical devices.

It should pass in about a day.

value.description: The moon is passing in front of the accretion disk, smothering what little light still spirals towards the enormous, abyssal black hole.

value.letterText: One of the moons of this planet has passed in front of the enormous, abyssal black hole. The abyssal eclipse has begun.

value.description: Some distant volcano or fire is choking the atmosphere with ash, significantly reducing the already-faint abyssal light. Temperatures will be colder and plants will grow slower.

value.letterText: Some distant volcano or fire has begun spewing massive quantities of ash into the atmosphere.\n\nAsh in the atmosphere will obscure the already-faint abyssal light. Temperatures will drop and plants will suffer for lack of light. It could pass in a few weeks, or it might last many quadrums.

value.descriptionFuture: a layer of ash will be deposited in the upper atmosphere, reducing the already-faint abyssal light around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], seriously harming the local ecosystem

value.description: A generalized disruption to body functioning caused by excessive exposure to heat. The victim becomes dizzy, weak, and confused. Recovery is quick once in a cool area, but if heat exposure continues, heat stroke gets worse until death.
A long duster coat. It was for blocking heat from the old sun, before it collapsed into a black hole.

Stylish yet rugged, it was for blocking heat from the old sun, before it collapsed into a black hole - and it gives anyone who wears it a bit of extra charm. It is the most important part of traditional western attire.
